q: 这个苹果很甜，你___。
zh: 这个苹果很甜，你尝尝。
py: zhè ge píng guǒ hěn tián nǐ cháng chang
en: This apple is sweet, have a taste.
why: An invitation to taste a little uses the doubled verb 尝尝. 尝过 would say you have tasted it before, and 尝着 or 正在尝 cannot form this suggestion.

q: 老板，我可以___这件衣服吗？
zh: 老板，我可以试一试这件衣服吗？
py: lǎo bǎn wǒ kě yǐ shì yī shì zhè jiàn yī fu ma
en: Boss, may I try this piece of clothing on?
why: Asking permission for a brief try needs V一V. 试了 and 在试 describe something already done or under way, which clashes with 可以……吗.

q: 我不知道这个多少钱，我去___。
zh: 我不知道这个多少钱，我去问问。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào zhè ge duō shao qián wǒ qù wèn wen
en: I don't know how much this is, I'll go and ask.
why: A planned quick enquiry takes the doubled verb 问问. 问过 means already asked and 在问 means asking right now; neither fits 我去.

q: 你再___，也许能找到更便宜的。
zh: 你再找找，也许能找到更便宜的。
py: nǐ zài zhǎo zhao yě xǔ néng zhǎo dào gèng pián yi de
en: Look around a bit more, you might find a cheaper one.
why: A suggestion to keep looking a little uses 找找. 找到 and 找完 are results, so they cannot follow 再 as an open suggestion; 在找 is progressive.

q: 这个沙发看着不错，你先坐___再决定吧。
zh: 这个沙发看着不错，你先坐坐再决定吧。
py: zhè ge shā fā kàn zhe bù cuò nǐ xiān zuò zuo zài jué dìng ba
en: This sofa looks good, sit on it for a bit before you decide.
why: 坐 + 坐 gives 坐坐, a brief try before deciding. 坐一 is incomplete and 坐了 or 坐过 state facts instead of making a suggestion.

q: 周末我打算去二手市场___，说不定能淘到便宜的桌子。
zh: 周末我打算去二手市场逛逛，说不定能淘到便宜的桌子。
py: zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn qù èr shǒu shì chǎng guàng guang shuō bu dìng néng táo dào pián yi de zhuō zi
en: This weekend I plan to browse the second-hand market, I might pick up a cheap table.
why: A plan to wander round casually takes the doubled verb 逛逛. 逛过 is experience, 在逛 is progressive, and 去 + 逛着 is not a possible pattern.

q: 逛了一上午，累了吧？我们___吧。
zh: 逛了一上午，累了吧？我们休息休息吧。
py: guàng le yī shàng wǔ lèi le ba wǒ men xiū xi xiū xi ba
en: We've been shopping all morning, tired? Let's take a little rest.
why: 休息 is a two-syllable compound, so it repeats as a whole: ABAB. AABB, 一 in the middle and AAB are all impossible for this verb.

q: 房间太乱了，周末我们一起___吧。
zh: 房间太乱了，周末我们一起打扫打扫吧。
py: fáng jiān tài luàn le zhōu mò wǒ men yī qǐ dǎ sǎo dǎ sǎo ba
en: The room is a mess, let's tidy up together this weekend.
why: 打扫 is an unsplittable compound, so ABAB. Copying 看一看 into 打扫一打扫 is the classic mistake, and 了 cannot sit inside a suggestion.

q: 买房子以前，你先___这个小区的情况。
zh: 买房子以前，你先了解了解这个小区的情况。
py: mǎi fáng zi yǐ qián nǐ xiān liǎo jiě liǎo jiě zhè ge xiǎo qū de qíng kuàng
en: Before buying a flat, first find out a bit about this neighbourhood.
why: 了解 is one solid verb, so it doubles as ABAB: 了解了解. AABB (了了解解) is for adjectives, and 一 never goes inside a two-syllable verb.

q: 我们想跟房东___租金的事，看看能不能便宜一点儿。
zh: 我们想跟房东商量商量租金的事，看看能不能便宜一点儿。
py: wǒ men xiǎng gēn fáng dōng shāng liang shāng liang zū jīn de shì kàn kan néng bu néng pián yi yī diǎn r
en: We'd like to talk the rent over with the landlord and see if it can be a bit cheaper.
why: 商量 is a compound verb and doubles as ABAB. 商商量量 and 商量一商量 are not words, and 商量商 is cut off halfway.

q: 这套房子的价格不低，回去以后我们得___。
zh: 这套房子的价格不低，回去以后我们得考虑考虑。
py: zhè tào fáng zi de jià gé bù dī huí qù yǐ hòu wǒ men děi kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ
en: This flat isn't cheap, when we get back we'll have to think it over.
why: 考虑 doubles as a whole word: 考虑考虑. The 一 pattern belongs only to one-syllable verbs, and AABB does not exist for verbs like this.

q: 吃完饭，我们去楼下___吧。
zh: 吃完饭，我们去楼下散散步吧。
py: chī wán fàn wǒ men qù lóu xià sàn san bù ba
en: After dinner, let's go for a little walk downstairs.
why: 散步 is verb + object, so only 散 doubles: 散散步. 散一步 is incomplete (it would need 散一散步), and 散着步 describes an ongoing state, not a plan.

q: 我们好久没见了，周末___吧。
zh: 我们好久没见了，周末见见面吧。
py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn le zhōu mò jiàn jian miàn ba
en: We haven't seen each other in ages, let's meet up at the weekend.
why: 见面 is verb + object (见 + 面), so double only the verb: 见见面. Doubling the object or tripling the verb makes nonsense.

q: 天气太热了，我想回家___。
zh: 天气太热了，我想回家洗洗澡。
py: tiān qì tài rè le wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xǐ xi zǎo
en: It's too hot, I want to go home and have a wash.
why: 洗澡 splits into 洗 + 澡, so the verb doubles: 洗洗澡. The object stays single and cannot be repeated or moved.

q: 我们很久没聊了，今晚想跟你___。
zh: 我们很久没聊了，今晚想跟你聊聊天。
py: wǒ men hěn jiǔ méi liáo le jīn wǎn xiǎng gēn nǐ liáo liao tiān
en: We haven't talked for ages, I'd like to have a chat with you tonight.
why: 聊天 is verb + object, giving AAB: 聊聊天. The other two options mix the order of verb and object parts in ways nobody says.

q: 下个月我搬家，你有空的话可以来___吗？
zh: 下个月我搬家，你有空的话可以来帮帮忙吗？
py: xià ge yuè wǒ bān jiā nǐ yǒu kòng de huà kě yǐ lái bāng bang máng ma
en: I'm moving next month, if you're free could you come and lend a hand?
why: 帮忙 is verb + object, so only 帮 doubles: 帮帮忙. Repeating the whole word (帮忙帮忙) is the ABAB pattern of unsplittable verbs.

q: 隔壁的邻居下班以后常常在阳台上___，声音不大。
zh: 隔壁的邻居下班以后常常在阳台上唱唱歌，声音不大。
py: gé bì de lín jū xià bān yǐ hòu cháng cháng zài yáng tái shàng chàng chang gē shēng yīn bù dà
en: After work the neighbour next door often sings a little on the balcony, not loudly.
why: 唱歌 is verb + object, so 唱唱歌. 唱歌唱歌 treats it as an unsplittable word, and 唱唱唱歌 triples the verb.

q: 他___价格，就走了。
zh: 他看了看价格，就走了。
py: tā kàn le kàn jià gé jiù zǒu le
en: He glanced at the price and left.
why: A brief action that was actually done puts 了 between the two verbs: 看了看. 看看了 puts 了 after the pair, which is the classic error.

q: 老板___，说：“三十块吧。”
zh: 老板笑了笑，说：“三十块吧。”
py: lǎo bǎn xiào le xiào shuō sān shí kuài ba
en: The boss smiled and said, 'Thirty yuan.'
why: The narrated action is complete, so 了 goes in the middle: 笑了笑. 笑笑了 is the misplaced form, and 笑着笑 is not a pattern.

q: 我___那件外套，觉得有点儿贵，就放下了。
zh: 我摸了摸那件外套，觉得有点儿贵，就放下了。
py: wǒ mō le mō nà jiàn wài tào jué de yǒu diǎn r guì jiù fàng xià le
en: I felt that coat, thought it a bit expensive and put it down.
why: A short action done and narrated takes V了V: 摸了摸. 了 goes between the two verbs, not after 摸摸 or 摸一摸.

q: 昨天我本来想去隔壁___，可是下雨了。
zh: 昨天我本来想去隔壁看看，可是下雨了。
py: zuó tiān wǒ běn lái xiǎng qù gé bì kàn kan kě shì xià yǔ le
en: Yesterday I meant to pop next door for a look, but it rained.
why: It is a plan that did not happen, so there is no action to mark with 了: 想去看看. 看了看 would claim the looking took place.

q: 房东听了我们的要求，___，说：“可以便宜两百。”
zh: 房东听了我们的要求，想了想，说：“可以便宜两百。”
py: fáng dōng tīng le wǒ men de yāo qiú xiǎng le xiǎng shuō kě yǐ pián yi liǎng bǎi
en: The landlord heard our request, thought for a moment and said, 'I can take two hundred off.'
why: The thinking is a finished brief action leading to what he said next, so 想了想. 想想了 and 想了想了 put 了 in the wrong place.

q: 请等___，我去拿钱包。
zh: 请等一下，我去拿钱包。
py: qǐng děng yī xià wǒ qù ná qián bāo
en: Please wait a moment, I'll go and get my wallet.
why: 一下 right after the verb makes a short polite request. 了一下 is for completed actions, 完 is a result and 一些 means 'some', so none of them gives 'a moment'.

q: 请你帮我___价格。
zh: 请你帮我算一下价格。
py: qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ suàn yī xià jià gé
en: Please work out the price for me.
why: A request uses 算一下. Doubling plus 一下 (算算一下) is never allowed, and 算了算 and 算一下了 state completion, not a request.

q: 你能帮___忙吗？我想把桌子搬到楼上。
zh: 你能帮一下忙吗？我想把桌子搬到楼上。
py: nǐ néng bāng yī xià máng ma wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhuō zi bān dào lóu shàng
en: Could you lend a hand? I want to move the table upstairs.
why: With a separable verb 一下 goes inside the word: 帮一下忙. 一下一下 repeats it, and 着 or 过 make no sense in a request.

q: 我刚才去物业问___，明天可以修水管。
zh: 我刚才去物业问了一下，明天可以修水管。
py: wǒ gāng cái qù wù yè wèn le yī xià míng tiān kě yǐ xiū shuǐ guǎn
en: I just asked the property office, they can fix the pipe tomorrow.
why: The asking is done and narrated, so 了 sits before 一下: 问了一下. 了 after 一下 or 着 before it does not form a past action.

q: 房东让我先___合同，再决定签不签。
zh: 房东让我先看一下合同，再决定签不签。
py: fáng dōng ràng wǒ xiān kàn yī xià hé tong zài jué dìng qiān bu qiān
en: The landlord asked me to take a look at the contract first and then decide whether to sign.
why: An instruction to look briefly is 看一下 before the object. 看看一下 stacks two softeners, and 看了一下 or 看着一下 do not fit 让我先…….

q: 我正在___电视，你等一会儿。
zh: 我正在看电视，你等一会儿。
py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn diàn shì nǐ děng yī huì r
en: I'm watching TV right now, wait a bit.
why: 正在 marks an action in progress, which takes the bare verb. 看看 and 看一下 mean a brief try and cannot combine with 正在.

q: 这个牌子的手机我___，很好用。
zh: 这个牌子的手机我用过，很好用。
py: zhè ge pái zi de shǒu jī wǒ yòng guo hěn hǎo yòng
en: I've used this brand of phone, it works well.
why: 过 marks experience and needs the bare verb: 用过. A doubled verb or 一下 means a short try and clashes with 过.

q: 他正在房间里___。
zh: 他正在房间里休息。
py: tā zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ xiū xi
en: He is resting in his room right now.
why: 正在 means in progress, so the bare verb 休息. 休息休息 and 休息一下 are for suggesting a short break, not for an action under way.

q: 钱我已经付___了。
zh: 钱我已经付完了。
py: qián wǒ yǐ jīng fù wán le
en: I've already finished paying.
why: The result complement 完 shows the action ended, so no doubling. 付付 or 付一下 would mean a brief try and cannot go with 已经……了.

q: 你___，我马上就回来。
zh: 你等我十分钟，我马上就回来。
py: nǐ děng wǒ shí fēn zhōng wǒ mǎ shàng jiù huí lái
en: Wait ten minutes for me, I'll be right back.
why: A stated duration (十分钟) takes the bare verb. Doubling or 一下 already means 'a short while', so a measured length clashes with it.

q: 我想把这份租房合同___再签字。
zh: 我想把这份租房合同看完再签字。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè fèn zū fáng hé tong kàn wán zài qiān zì
en: I want to finish reading this rental contract before signing.
why: 完 is a result complement saying the reading reaches its end, so the verb stays bare: 看完. 看看完 and 看一下完 are impossible.

q: 这个商场我___，里面有很多便宜的东西。
zh: 这个商场我逛过，里面有很多便宜的东西。
py: zhè ge shāng chǎng wǒ guàng guo lǐ miàn yǒu hěn duō pián yi de dōng xi
en: I've been shopping at this mall, there's lots of cheap stuff inside.
why: Experience with 过 uses the bare verb: 逛过. Doubled 逛逛 or 逛一下 describe a brief casual go and cannot take 过.

q: 房东说得太快，我没听___。
zh: 房东说得太快，我没听懂。
py: fáng dōng shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: The landlord spoke too fast, I didn't understand.
why: 听懂 is verb + result complement 懂. Doubling (听听) means listen briefly and cannot give 'understand'; neither can 没 + 听一下.

q: 邻居正在楼上___家具，声音特别大。
zh: 邻居正在楼上搬家具，声音特别大。
py: lín jū zhèng zài lóu shàng bān jiā jù shēng yīn tè bié dà
en: The neighbour upstairs is moving furniture, it's extremely loud.
why: 正在 needs the bare verb. 搬搬 or 搬一下 would suggest a brief casual move and cannot describe noisy work in progress.

q: 这个苹果___的，看起来很好吃。
zh: 这个苹果红红的，看起来很好吃。
py: zhè ge píng guǒ hóng hóng de kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo chī
en: This apple is nice and red, it looks delicious.
why: A doubled adjective + 的 paints a picture and carries its own degree, so 红红的. Adding 很 or 非常 in front is the classic error.

q: 她的脸圆圆___，很可爱。
zh: 她的脸圆圆的，很可爱。
py: tā de liǎn yuán yuán de hěn kě ài
en: Her face is nice and round, she's cute.
why: A doubled adjective used as a predicate ends in 的: 圆圆的. 地 is only for adverbs before a verb and 得 introduces a complement.

q: 他的头发___，看起来很精神。
zh: 他的头发短短的，看起来很精神。
py: tā de tóu fa duǎn duǎn de kàn qǐ lái hěn jīng shen
en: His hair is nice and short, he looks sharp.
why: The doubled form already has degree, so no 很 and no 不 in front: 短短的. Both other options stack a degree or negation on it.

q: 她买了一个___的包，很好看。
zh: 她买了一个小小的包，很好看。
py: tā mǎi le yī gè xiǎo xiǎo de bāo hěn hǎo kàn
en: She bought a cute little bag, it's pretty.
why: Before a noun the doubled adjective takes 的: 小小的包. 很 cannot go in front, and 地 belongs to adverbs, not to noun modifiers.

q: 新房子的客厅___，阳光很好。
zh: 新房子的客厅大大的，阳光很好。
py: xīn fáng zi de kè tīng dà dà de yáng guāng hěn hǎo
en: The new flat's living room is nice and big, with plenty of sun.
why: 大大的 is complete as it stands. 很 or 不 cannot be added to a doubled adjective.

q: 他穿着一件___衬衫，站在商店门口。
zh: 他穿着一件白白的衬衫，站在商店门口。
py: tā chuān zhe yī jiàn bái bái de chèn shān zhàn zài shāng diàn mén kǒu
en: He was wearing a nice white shirt, standing at the shop door.
why: The doubled adjective before a noun needs 的: 白白的衬衫. Without 的 it is incomplete, and 很 cannot join a doubled adjective.

q: 超市里有一种___的小西瓜，只要十块钱。
zh: 超市里有一种圆圆的小西瓜，只要十块钱。
py: chāo shì lǐ yǒu yī zhǒng yuán yuán de xiǎo xī guā zhǐ yào shí kuài qián
en: The supermarket has a kind of little round watermelon for only ten yuan.
why: 圆圆的 describes the shape vividly and needs no degree word. 很圆圆 and 非常圆圆 break the rule that a doubled adjective carries its own degree.

q: 孩子们___地走进了新家。
zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地走进了新家。
py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de zǒu jìn le xīn jiā
en: The children walked happily into the new home.
why: An ordinary two-syllable adjective doubles as AABB before 地. 高兴高兴 is the verb pattern, and 很 cannot join a doubled form.

q: 她把新房子打扫得___的。
zh: 她把新房子打扫得干干净净的。
py: tā bǎ xīn fáng zi dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng de
en: She cleaned the new flat until it was spotless.
why: 干净 is an ordinary adjective, so AABB after 得: 干干净净. ABAB is only for comparison-type words like 雪白, and 很 is never added.

q: 她把鞋子摆得___的，放在门口。
zh: 她把鞋子摆得整整齐齐的，放在门口。
py: tā bǎ xié zi bǎi de zhěng zhěng qí qí de fàng zài mén kǒu
en: She arranged the shoes neatly at the door.
why: 整齐 is an ordinary adjective and doubles as AABB: 整整齐齐. ABAB and AAB are both wrong shapes for it.

q: 他的手在外面冻了很久，现在___的。
zh: 他的手在外面冻了很久，现在冰凉冰凉的。
py: tā de shǒu zài wài miàn dòng le hěn jiǔ xiàn zài bīng liáng bīng liáng de
en: His hands were out in the cold a long time, they're ice-cold now.
why: 冰凉 compares to ice, so the whole word repeats as ABAB: 冰凉冰凉的. A cut-off 冰凉冰 is wrong, and 很 never goes before the doubled form.

q: 新房子刚刷完墙，四面都是___的。
zh: 新房子刚刷完墙，四面都是雪白雪白的。
py: xīn fáng zi gāng shuā wán qiáng sì miàn dōu shì xuě bái xuě bái de
en: The flat's walls have just been painted, all four sides are snow-white.
why: 雪白 is a comparison-type word ('white as snow'), so it repeats as ABAB: 雪白雪白的. AABB (雪雪白白) is not used, and 很 is impossible.

q: 邻居在睡觉，请你___关门。
zh: 邻居在睡觉，请你轻轻地关门。
py: lín jū zài shuì jiào qǐng nǐ qīng qīng de guān mén
en: The neighbour is sleeping, please close the door gently.
why: Manner goes before the verb as doubled adjective + 地: 轻轻地关门. 很 cannot join a doubled form, and a single 轻 cannot take 地 like that.

q: 你说得太快了，请___说。
zh: 你说得太快了，请慢慢地说。
py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài le qǐng màn màn de shuō
en: You're speaking too fast, please say it slowly.
why: 慢慢地 is placed before 说 to show how it is said. 很慢慢地 adds a forbidden 很, and 慢地 is not a form.

q: 买这么贵的东西，你要___想一想。
zh: 买这么贵的东西，你要好好想一想。
py: mǎi zhè me guì de dōng xi nǐ yào hǎo hǎo xiǎng yī xiǎng
en: You're buying something this expensive, so think it over properly.
why: 好好 sits before the verb as a manner word. 很好好 stacks a degree word on a doubled form, and 得 would put the manner after the verb.

q: 他___地把钱数了三遍。
zh: 他仔仔细细地把钱数了三遍。
py: tā zǐ zǐ xì xì de bǎ qián shǔ le sān biàn
en: He counted the money carefully three times.
why: An ordinary two-syllable adjective used as manner doubles as AABB before 地: 仔仔细细地. 仔细仔细 and 很仔仔细细 are both wrong shapes.

q: 孩子___地坐在新沙发上看书。
zh: 孩子安安静静地坐在新沙发上看书。
py: hái zi ān ān jìng jìng de zuò zài xīn shā fā shàng kàn shū
en: The child sat quietly on the new sofa reading.
why: AABB (安安静静) + 地 goes before the verb to describe the manner. ABAB is not an adjective pattern here and 很 cannot be added.

q: 拿到新房的钥匙，一家人___搬了进去。
zh: 拿到新房的钥匙，一家人开开心心地搬了进去。
py: ná dào xīn fáng de yào shi yī jiā rén kāi kāi xīn xīn de bān le jìn qù
en: With the keys to the new flat in hand, the family moved in happily.
why: The manner phrase AABB + 地 comes before the verb 搬. 开心开心地 uses the wrong pattern for an adjective, and 很 is excluded.

q: 为了买到合适的房子，他___地看了二十多套。
zh: 为了买到合适的房子，他认认真真地看了二十多套。
py: wèi le mǎi dào hé shì de fáng zi tā rèn rèn zhēn zhēn de kàn le èr shí duō tào
en: To find the right flat, he conscientiously viewed more than twenty.
why: 认真 doubles as AABB before 地: 认认真真地看. ABAB (认真认真) and a 很 in front of the doubled form are both ruled out.

zh: 你看看这条裤子吧。
py: nǐ kàn kan zhè tiáo kù zi ba
en: Have a look at these trousers.
why: The doubled verb sits right before its object, giving a soft suggestion. 这条裤子 may also be fronted as the topic.

zh: 我想试一试这双鞋。
py: wǒ xiǎng shì yī shì zhè shuāng xié
en: I'd like to try on these shoes.
why: V一V stays together and comes before the object. 这双鞋 can also be fronted as the topic.

zh: 我们一起打扫打扫房间吧。
py: wǒ men yī qǐ dǎ sǎo dǎ sǎo fáng jiān ba
en: Let's tidy the room together.
why: ABAB stays as one unit between 一起 and the object. The object may also be fronted as a topic.

zh: 我们去公园散散步吧。
py: wǒ men qù gōng yuán sàn san bù ba
en: Let's go for a little walk in the park.
why: 散散步 is AAB and stays whole after 去公园. Splitting it or moving 吧 gives no valid order.

zh: 有空的话我们见见面吧。
py: yǒu kòng de huà wǒ men jiàn jian miàn ba
en: If you have time, let's meet up.
why: 见见面 (AAB) closes the clause, and the condition may come before or after 我们.

zh: 她摸了摸沙发没有买。
py: tā mō le mō shā fā méi yǒu mǎi
en: She felt the sofa and didn't buy it.
why: V了V is one tile for the brief completed action, followed by its object and the next event. 沙发 may also be fronted as the topic.

zh: 老板想了想把价格降了五块钱。
py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng le xiǎng bǎ jià gé jiàng le wǔ kuài qián
en: The boss thought for a moment and lowered the price by five yuan.
why: 想了想 comes first as the brief completed action, then the 把 clause for what he did next.

zh: 请你帮我看一下。
py: qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ kàn yī xià
en: Please take a look for me.
why: 一下 comes straight after the verb 看, and the whole request follows 请你.

zh: 我想跟邻居见一下面。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn lín jū jiàn yī xià miàn
en: I'd like to meet the neighbour briefly.
why: In the separable verb 见面, 一下 goes between 见 and 面.

zh: 你能帮我问一下房东吗？
py: nǐ néng bāng wǒ wèn yī xià fáng dōng ma
en: Could you ask the landlord for me?
why: 一下 sits right after 问 and before the object 房东; 吗 closes the question.

zh: 我正在打扫厨房。
py: wǒ zhèng zài dǎ sǎo chú fáng
en: I'm cleaning the kitchen right now.
why: 正在 takes the bare verb 打扫 and follows the subject. 厨房 can also be fronted as the topic.

zh: 我在这个小区住过两年。
py: wǒ zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù guo liǎng nián
en: I lived in this neighbourhood for two years.
why: The bare verb with 过 is followed by the duration. 在这个小区 may come before or after 我.

zh: 她的眼睛大大的。
py: tā de yǎn jing dà dà de
en: Her eyes are nice and big.
why: The doubled adjective with 的 comes last as the predicate, after its noun.

zh: 他轻轻地关上了门。
py: tā qīng qīng de guān shàng le mén
en: He gently closed the door.
why: The manner word 轻轻地 goes before the verb. 了 may follow 关上 or close the sentence.

zh: 我们要好好地商量一下租金的事。
py: wǒ men yào hǎo hǎo de shāng liang yī xià zū jīn de shì
en: We need to discuss the rent properly.
why: 好好地 goes before 商量; 一下 follows the verb. The topic 租金的事 may be fronted.

src_py: nǐ kàn zhè ge shǒu jī
task: Soften it by doubling the verb.
zh: 你看看这个手机。
py: nǐ kàn kan zhè ge shǒu jī
en: Have a look at this phone.
why: Doubling 看 turns the bare command into a casual 'have a look'. The object may also be fronted.

src_py: wǒ men xiū xi yī xià ba
task: Say the same with a doubled verb.
zh: 我们休息休息吧。
py: wǒ men xiū xi xiū xi ba
en: Let's take a little rest.
why: 一下 and doubling do the same job, and 休息 doubles as ABAB with no 一.

src: 晚饭后我想跟邻居聊天。
src_py: wǎn fàn hòu wǒ xiǎng gēn lín jū liáo tiān
task: Make it a casual little chat.
zh: 晚饭后我想跟邻居聊聊天。
py: wǎn fàn hòu wǒ xiǎng gēn lín jū liáo liao tiān
en: After dinner I'd like to have a chat with the neighbour.
why: 聊天 is verb + object, so only 聊 doubles: 聊聊天. 晚饭后 may come before or after 我.

src: 邻居敲了一下门，就进来了。
src_py: lín jū qiāo le yī xià mén jiù jìn lái le
task: Say it with V了V instead of 一下.
zh: 邻居敲了敲门就进来了。
py: lín jū qiāo le qiāo mén jiù jìn lái le
en: The neighbour knocked on the door and came in.
why: For a done brief action with a one-syllable verb, 了 goes between the doubled verbs: 敲了敲.

src_py: qǐng nǐ suàn suan jià gé
task: Say it with 一下 instead of doubling.
zh: 请你算一下价格。
py: qǐng nǐ suàn yī xià jià gé
en: Please work out the price.
why: 算算 becomes 算一下, with 一下 right after the verb. The object may be fronted.

src_py: wǒ gāng cái wèn le fáng dōng
task: Say you asked briefly, with 一下.
zh: 我刚才问了一下房东。
py: wǒ gāng cái wèn le yī xià fáng dōng
en: I just had a quick word with the landlord.
why: Done and brief: 了 comes after the verb, then 一下, then the object. 刚才 can sit before or after 我.

src_py: wǒ kàn kan zhè jiàn chèn shān
task: Say you are looking at it right now.
zh: 我正在看这件衬衫。
py: wǒ zhèng zài kàn zhè jiàn chèn shān
en: I'm looking at this shirt right now.
why: 正在 marks an action in progress and needs the bare verb, so the doubling is dropped.

src_py: tā de tóu fa hěn cháng
task: Make it vivid with a doubled adjective.
zh: 她的头发长长的。
py: tā de tóu fa cháng cháng de
en: Her hair is nice and long.
why: The doubled adjective + 的 replaces 很 + adjective: 很 must be removed.

src: 他把房间打扫得很干净。
src_py: tā bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de hěn gān jìng
zh: 他把房间打扫得干干净净的。
py: tā bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng de
en: He cleaned the room until it was spotless.
why: 干净 doubles as AABB, 很 is dropped, and 的 closes the description.

src_py: qǐng nǐ shuō de màn yī diǎn r
task: Say it with a doubled adjective before the verb.
zh: 请你慢慢地说。
py: qǐng nǐ màn màn de shuō
en: Please speak slowly.
why: The manner moves before the verb as 慢慢地, replacing the complement 得慢一点儿 after it.

s: 我想有有一套大房子。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng yǒu yǒu yī tào dà fáng zi
zh: 我想有一套大房子。
py: wǒ xiǎng yǒu yī tào dà fáng zi
en: I'd like to have a big flat.
why: 有 is not a deliberate action, so it cannot be doubled. Only action verbs like 看 or 试 take reduplication.

s: 你怎么不问问房东？
s_py: nǐ zěn me bù wèn wen fáng dōng
zh: 你怎么不问问房东？
py: nǐ zěn me bù wèn wen fáng dōng
en: Why don't you ask the landlord?
why: Correct: a doubled verb can follow 不 in a pushing question like 你怎么不问问. It is only plain negative statements that cannot take 不 + doubling.

s: 你先考虑一考虑再买。
s_py: nǐ xiān kǎo lǜ yī kǎo lǜ zài mǎi
zh: 你先考虑考虑再买。
py: nǐ xiān kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ zài mǎi
en: Think it over before you buy.
why: 一 can sit between two copies of a one-syllable verb only. A two-syllable verb doubles as ABAB with nothing inside.

s: 房东说他会考虑考虑我们的要求。
s_py: fáng dōng shuō tā huì kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ wǒ men de yāo qiú
zh: 房东说他会考虑考虑我们的要求。
py: fáng dōng shuō tā huì kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ wǒ men de yāo qiú
en: The landlord said he'd think about our request.
why: Correct: 考虑 is an unsplittable compound, so ABAB 考虑考虑 is the right shape, and a future 会 takes no 了.

s: 忙了一天，我想先洗澡洗澡再吃饭。
s_py: máng le yī tiān wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ zǎo xǐ zǎo zài chī fàn
zh: 忙了一天，我想先洗洗澡再吃饭。
py: máng le yī tiān wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ xi zǎo zài chī fàn
en: After a busy day I want to have a wash before eating.
why: 洗澡 is verb + object, so only 洗 doubles. Repeating the whole word treats it as an unsplittable compound.

s: 小王看看了手表，就走了。
s_py: xiǎo wáng kàn kan le shǒu biǎo jiù zǒu le
zh: 小王看了看手表，就走了。
py: xiǎo wáng kàn le kàn shǒu biǎo jiù zǒu le
en: Xiao Wang glanced at his watch and left.
why: For a brief action that was done, 了 goes between the two verbs. 看看了 puts it after the pair.

s: 上个月我就想去物业问问，一直没有时间。
s_py: shàng ge yuè wǒ jiù xiǎng qù wù yè wèn wen yī zhí méi yǒu shí jiān
zh: 上个月我就想去物业问问，一直没有时间。
py: shàng ge yuè wǒ jiù xiǎng qù wù yè wèn wen yī zhí méi yǒu shí jiān
en: Since last month I've wanted to ask the property office, but I never had time.
why: Correct: this is a wish that never happened, so the doubled verb takes no 了. 了 belongs only to a brief action actually done.

s: 你看看一下这张发票。
s_py: nǐ kàn kan yī xià zhè zhāng fā piào
zh: 你看一下这张发票。
py: nǐ kàn yī xià zhè zhāng fā piào
en: Take a look at this receipt.
why: Doubling and 一下 do the same job, so use one only. 看看一下 stacks both.

s: 我想跟房东见一下面。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng gēn fáng dōng jiàn yī xià miàn
zh: 我想跟房东见一下面。
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn fáng dōng jiàn yī xià miàn
en: I'd like to meet the landlord briefly.
why: Correct: 见面 is separable, so 一下 goes inside it, between 见 and 面.

s: 老板正在算算账，请你等一会儿。
s_py: lǎo bǎn zhèng zài suàn suan zhàng qǐng nǐ děng yī huì r
zh: 老板正在算账，请你等一会儿。
py: lǎo bǎn zhèng zài suàn zhàng qǐng nǐ děng yī huì r
en: The boss is doing the accounts, please wait a moment.
why: 正在 marks an action in progress, which needs the bare verb. A doubled 算算 cannot follow it.

s: 我们已经把房间收拾收拾完了。
s_py: wǒ men yǐ jīng bǎ fáng jiān shōu shi shōu shi wán le
zh: 我们已经把房间收拾完了。
py: wǒ men yǐ jīng bǎ fáng jiān shōu shi wán le
en: We've finished tidying the room.
why: The result complement 完 says the tidying reached its end, which clashes with the 'a little bit' meaning of ABAB.

s: 我在门口等一下了半个小时。
s_py: wǒ zài mén kǒu děng yī xià le bàn ge xiǎo shí
zh: 我在门口等了半个小时。
py: wǒ zài mén kǒu děng le bàn ge xiǎo shí
en: I waited at the door for half an hour.
why: A stated duration needs the bare verb: 等了半个小时. 一下 means 'a moment' and cannot sit before a measured length of time.

s: 那个新邻居我还没见过面。
s_py: nà ge xīn lín jū wǒ hái méi jiàn guo miàn
zh: 那个新邻居我还没见过面。
py: nà ge xīn lín jū wǒ hái méi jiàn guo miàn
en: I haven't met that new neighbour yet.
why: Correct: 过 takes the bare verb inside the separable word (见过面). Doubling it would be wrong here.

s: 我们休息一会儿再去逛街吧。
s_py: wǒ men xiū xi yī huì r zài qù guàng jiē ba
zh: 我们休息一会儿再去逛街吧。
py: wǒ men xiū xi yī huì r zài qù guàng jiē ba
en: Let's rest for a bit and then go shopping.
why: Correct: 一会儿 is a stated duration, so the verb is bare. Doubling is what you do instead of giving a time.

s: 这个杯子很小小的，才十块钱。
s_py: zhè ge bēi zi hěn xiǎo xiǎo de cái shí kuài qián
zh: 这个杯子小小的，才十块钱。
py: zhè ge bēi zi xiǎo xiǎo de cái shí kuài qián
en: This cup is small, only ten yuan.
why: A doubled adjective carries its own degree, so 很 cannot be added.

s: 这件衣服红红的，很好看。
s_py: zhè jiàn yī fu hóng hóng de hěn hǎo kàn
zh: 这件衣服红红的，很好看。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu hóng hóng de hěn hǎo kàn
en: This piece of clothing is nice and red, it looks great.
why: Correct: 红红的 stands on its own. The 很 belongs to the next clause 很好看, not to the doubled adjective.

s: 孩子们高兴高兴地跑进了新房子。
s_py: hái zi men gāo xìng gāo xìng de pǎo jìn le xīn fáng zi
zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地跑进了新房子。
py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de pǎo jìn le xīn fáng zi
en: The children ran happily into the new house.
why: An adjective used as manner doubles as AABB. 高兴高兴 is a verb pattern and cannot describe how they ran.

s: 她的衬衫洗得雪白雪白的。
s_py: tā de chèn shān xǐ de xuě bái xuě bái de
zh: 她的衬衫洗得雪白雪白的。
py: tā de chèn shān xǐ de xuě bái xuě bái de
en: Her shirt has been washed snow-white.
why: Correct: 雪白 is a comparison-type word, so the whole word repeats as ABAB with 的, and no 很 is needed.

s: 你说慢慢地，我听不懂。
s_py: nǐ shuō màn màn de wǒ tīng bu dǒng
zh: 你慢慢地说，我听不懂。
py: nǐ màn màn de shuō wǒ tīng bu dǒng
en: Say it slowly, I can't understand.
why: Manner words with 地 go before the verb. English puts 'slowly' after it, but 说慢慢地 is not Chinese.

s: 你好好看看这份合同再签字。
s_py: nǐ hǎo hǎo kàn kan zhè fèn hé tong zài qiān zì
zh: 你好好看看这份合同再签字。
py: nǐ hǎo hǎo kàn kan zhè fèn hé tong zài qiān zì
en: Read this contract properly before you sign.
why: Correct: 好好 as a manner word and the doubled verb 看看 can appear together, and 好好 usually needs no 地.
